scope: descriptive counts over the whole encounter as annotated, with no history cut; not predictors. One counted unit is an answer and an investor question it responds to. The next move is read from turn order, whatever exchange the model put each turn in: the first investor turn after the answer, passing over founder turns and turns that are no reaction
label: pitch-held-out estimate

definitions.asker: what the investor who asked does next: positive_receipt (accepts), follow_up_question, challenge, other_by_asker, other_investor (another investor speaks first), no_reaction (no further investor turn, or the next one is decision talk)
definitions.panel: the first investor reaction by anyone, the asker or another investor: receipt (accepts), question, challenge, other, none (no investor reacts)
definitions.hard: questions of severity 2 (asks for substantiation) or 3 (contests a claim)
definitions.support: whether the answer gives checkable support
